scope: Actual workbook import, Markdown/KaTeX render, export/reimport in fresh Chromium

formulaVisualReview.scope: Controller visual review of all four formulas in each locale/theme; not native-prose review

limits: No downloaded runtimes, packages, models, or external requests
No Android, Pro, live user browser profile, Git writes, or remote APIs

No native-speaker or native-prose review is claimed by rendering checks
Only English educational Python was executed, offline with preinstalled NumPy
